relevance_rank_note: Isogenic human iPSC astrocytes; measures endocytic uptake and endosome markers (surrogates for receptor recycling), including a null for the Rab11 recycling endosome.

description: Isogenic APOE4 iPSC-derived astrocytes internalized less fluorescent transferrin in a 5-min pulse than APOE3 astrocytes, without lower transferrin-receptor expression, indicating reduced clathrin-mediated uptake of a recycling receptor's ligand.
quote: Using fluorescently-tagged Tf, we again observed that APOE4 astrocytes internalized less Tf than APOE3 astrocytes.
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less transferrin internalization per cell in astrocytes)
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, isogenic APOE3 (parental) vs CRISPR-edited APOE4; Alexa647-transferrin 25 ug/mL, 5 min at 37C, confocal quantification of Tf intensity per cell. In-vitro iPSC-derived (fetal-like) astrocytes. Donor note (Fig S1A): APOE3 parental line Coriell AG09173 from a 75-year-old unaffected female; APOE4 parental line AG10788 from an 87-year-old female with confirmed AD diagnosis, so one isogenic pair is on an aged AD-donor background.
human_check: Effect left N/A (ambiguous_panel, team leader decision 2026-11-19): the Fig 1G transferrin y-axis is mislabelled. Its four equally spaced ticks read 500000, 1e6, 2e6, 2e6; on a linear axis the third tick would be 1.5e6 and the origin ~0.25e6, giving roughly E3 ~1.40e6 vs E4 ~0.95e6 (~32% lower), but taken at face value the labels give ~49%. The figure cannot settle which. P=0.036 is printed on the panel itself, not in the legend text. APOE3 parental line is Coriell AG09173 (Suppl Fig S1A), the same donor as the AG09173 set in 42239208.

description: Second isogenic pair (APOE4 parental line): APOE4 astrocytes internalized less transferrin than isogenic APOE3 astrocytes in a 5-min pulse, a non-significant trend (p=0.053) that the authors describe as confirming the first pair.
quote: These results were confirmed in astrocytes derived from an independent iPSC line (Figure S1A) (Lin et al., 2018), where we again observed that APOE4 astrocytes exhibit a similar genotype-dependent decrease in early clathrin-mediated endocytosis (Figure S2I)
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, second isogenic pair: APOE4 (parental, AG10788) vs CRISPR-edited APOE3; fluorescent transferrin 5 min pulse, microscopy, transferrin intensity per cell, 30-50 cells per sample. Donor note (Fig S1A): APOE3 parental line Coriell AG09173 from a 75-year-old unaffected female; APOE4 parental line AG10788 from an 87-year-old female with confirmed AD diagnosis, so one isogenic pair is on an aged AD-donor background.
human_check: Effect read off S2I bars (APOE3 about 1.8e6 vs APOE4 about 1.3e6 per cell). P=0.053 printed on the panel; n=12-16 samples from the S2 legend. Marked against because not significant, though the authors present it as a confirmation. Re-checked 2026-11-21 against the Cell Reports supplement (mmc1.pdf, Figure S2 and legend): bars, P=0.053, n=12-16 (S2I) and n=7 (S2A) all match.

description: AGAINST: Rab11-positive recycling endosome levels did not differ between isogenic APOE3 and APOE4 iPSC-derived astrocytes, in contrast to the early-endosome decrease. No P value is printed.
quote: we noted no difference in Rab11 (recycling endosome) levels between cells of the APOE3 and APOE4 genotype (Figure S2A,B)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in Rab11+ recycling endosomes in astrocytes) [AGAINST]
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, isogenic APOE3 vs APOE4; Rab11 immunofluorescence intensity per cell, APOE3 (parental) vs APOE4 (isogenic), 30-50 cells per sample. Donor note (Fig S1A): APOE3 parental line Coriell AG09173 from a 75-year-old unaffected female; APOE4 parental line AG10788 from an 87-year-old female with confirmed AD diagnosis, so one isogenic pair is on an aged AD-donor background.
human_check: S2A bars: APOE3 (parental) about 1.00 vs APOE4 (isogenic) about 0.97 Rab11 intensity per cell; no P value printed. n=7 samples of 30-50 cells (S2 legend). Supplement read in Chrome via PMC 2026-11-19. APOE3 parental line is Coriell AG09173 (Suppl Fig S1A), the same donor as the AG09173 set in 42239208. Re-checked 2026-11-21 against the Cell Reports supplement (mmc1.pdf, Figure S2 and legend): bars, P=0.053, n=12-16 (S2I) and n=7 (S2A) all match.

description: APOE4 iPSC astrocytes had fewer EEA1-positive early-endosome puncta per cell than isogenic APOE3 astrocytes.
quote: We observed that the number of both Rab5 positive and EEA1 positive puncta were decreased in APOE4 compared to APOE3 astrocytes (Figure 1D–F).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (fewer EEA1+ early endosomes in astrocytes)
system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, isogenic APOE3 (parental) vs APOE4; EEA1 immunofluorescence, 80-100 cells per sample. human_check: Effect ~58% reduction read off bars (~30 vs ~12.5 puncta/cell); P printed on panel. APOE3 parental line is Coriell AG09173 (Suppl Fig S1A), the same donor as the AG09173 set in 42239208.
